Install on your phone

Open this link in Chrome on Android. Tap Install app above, or use Chrome’s menu → Add to Home screen → Install. If opened inside another app, choose Open in browser first.

Listen with the screen off

Start playback, then lock your phone. Native audio and media controls let Chrome continue in the background. Keep the app open; calls, battery restrictions, and your browser may interrupt it. If it stops, return here and tap play. Screen-off playback needs a check on your own phone.

Take it offline

Tap Save for offline and wait for the ready message before disconnecting. Saved files may be cleared if storage is low.

A sound of its own

Rain plays by itself unless you raise the separate pink-noise slider. Your mix is prepared as one 32-minute native audio track, so background playback needs no JavaScript refills. The joins inside the track are continuous; a brief pause may occur when the browser repeats the full track. Adjusting the blend rebuilds and restarts the track. Your mix is saved on this device.
